reference.role: True-scale mechanical implementation of the eight populated reference boards

future.role: Conditional miniaturized implanted SCCI package and 36 functional lead interfaces

harness.role: Actual mating interfaces, cross-stage port bridge and labeled cable planning

boundaries: The reference and future package are distinct embodiments; no scale transform converts the electronics into an implant.
Original Stage 1 through Stage 4 inputs remain immutable.
Nominal BRep fit checks do not establish physical performance, implant qualification or biological efficacy.
Retained expert-informed motor learning and function-specific physiological feedback remain the two conditional application goals.
A dedicated illustrated technical drawing package and native CAD entry point complete this digital mechanical stage.
